summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for the SSRRT multi-page site. All dedicated routes, shared navigation, images, mobile navigation, overflow behavior, and DEMO donation submission passed.
action_items: No action required for the tested scope.
Payment gateway and receipt email remain intentionally MOCKED/DEMO ONLY until provider details are supplied.
critical_code_review_comments: Existing backend test requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported before pytest; without environment loading it fails during collection, although the configured run passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ demo donations through API and browser acceptance tests; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified /, /mother, /goshala, /ashram, /seva, /volunteering, /shop, /events, /donate, and /contact at the public URL. Verified images, desktop footer/header, mobile menu route navigation, no mobile horizontal overflow, donation purpose/amount/recurring/donor fields, POST success confirmation, API root, and invalid amount handling.
rca of the issue: No application issue reproduced. Initial browser attempt used an incorrect test selector (donor-name-input); implementation correctly emits donor-donor_name-input from the donor_name field key. The corrected test passed.
